sheet.title: Starting square
sheet.instruction: Set one square down like a diamond, with one corner pointing toward you. Put the color you want on the inside floor face down.
sheet.result: Four tips surround the uncreased sheet.

mark-across.title: Mark the crosswise diagonal
mark-across.instruction: Bring the far tip to the near tip and crease the folded edge.
mark-across.result: The doubled triangle points toward you.

open-across.title: Open the square
open-across.instruction: Return the far tip to its starting place.
open-across.result: A crease joins the left and right tips.

mark-center.title: Mark the lengthwise diagonal
mark-center.instruction: Bring the right tip to the left tip and crease.

open-center.title: Find the center
open-center.instruction: Open the right half again. Find the crossing of the two marks.
open-center.result: The diagonals meet at the middle of the square.

left-to-center.title: Fold the left tip in
left-to-center.instruction: Bring the left corner to the crossing and press its new edge.
left-to-center.result: One triangle covers the left part of the sheet.

right-to-center.title: Fold the right tip in
right-to-center.instruction: Bring the right corner to the same crossing.
right-to-center.result: Two tips meet above the center.

end-tips.title: Bring both ends in
end-tips.instruction: Fold the near and far tips to the crossing.
end-tips.result: Four flaps meet in a smaller square.

mark-ends.title: Mark the end walls
mark-ends.instruction: Bring both folded end edges to the crosswise center crease. Press each fold.
mark-ends.result: The edges meet and the two floor boundaries are creased.

open-end-marks.title: Reopen the wall marks
open-end-marks.instruction: Lift both end edges back to the smaller square.
open-end-marks.result: Two parallel marks bound the future floor.

release-ends.title: Release the long ends
release-ends.instruction: Unfold the near and far corner flaps. Keep the left and right flaps down.
release-ends.result: Two long points extend beyond the side flaps.

mark-sides.title: Mark the side walls
mark-sides.instruction: Fold the long left and right edges to the lengthwise centerline. Crease through both plies.
mark-sides.result: The side-wall hinges run the length of the strip.

stand-sides.title: Stand the sides up
stand-sides.instruction: Open both long folds halfway until the side walls stand at right angles to the floor.
stand-sides.result: A channel runs between the two upright walls.

raise-far-end.title: Raise the far end
raise-far-end.instruction: Lift the far end on its floor mark. Push both corner diagonals inward as the end rises.
raise-far-end.result: Two triangle pairs lie against the inside of the standing end.

bend-far-tip.title: Bend the far tip out
bend-far-tip.instruction: One wall-height above the rim, bend the pointed half of the extension outward to a right angle.
bend-far-tip.result: The point projects outside the box.

line-far-wall.title: Line the far wall
line-far-wall.instruction: Roll the extension inward over the rim and down over both gussets. Press the tip onto the floor.
line-far-wall.result: The far corners are covered and the tip reaches the center.

raise-near-end.title: Raise the near end
raise-near-end.instruction: Lift the near end on its floor mark while guiding both corner diagonals inward.
raise-near-end.result: The last two pairs of triangles sit inside the near end.

bend-near-tip.title: Bend the near tip out
bend-near-tip.instruction: Bend the pointed half outward, one wall-height above the rim, just as at the far end.
bend-near-tip.result: The last point extends toward you.

line-near-wall.title: Lock the box
line-near-wall.instruction: Wrap the extension over the near rim, cover the gussets and press the point to the floor center.
line-near-wall.result: Four upright walls enclose an open square. The end flaps hold the corners in place.
